title: Preparation and characterization of highly crystalline hydroxyapatite (HAp) from the scales of an anadromous fish (Tenualosa ilisha): a comparative study with the freshwater fish scale (Labeo rohita) derived HAp
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39874-39889

HAp from Tenualosa ilisha scales had a monoclinic structure, while HAp from Labeo rohita scales had a hexagonal structure, despite identical preparation methods.
